import dartfx.ddi.ddicodebook as cb

xml_content = """<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<codeBook xmlns="ddi:codebook:2_6" version="2.6" ID="DARTFX-SURVEY-2026">
  <docDscr>
    <citation>
      <titlStmt>
        <titl>Documentation for Demo Socio-Economic Survey</titl>
      </titlStmt>
    </citation>
  </docDscr>
  <stdyDscr>
    <citation>
      <titlStmt>
        <titl>Demo Socio-Economic Survey 2026</titl>
        <IDNo agency="DataArtifex">DARTFX-2026-V1</IDNo>
      </titlStmt>
      <rspStmt>
        <AuthEnty>Data Artifex Research Unit</AuthEnty>
      </rspStmt>
      <prodStmt>
        <producer>Data Artifex</producer>
        <prodDate date="2026-10-25">October 25, 2026</prodDate>
      </prodStmt>
    </citation>
    <stdyInfo>
      <abstract>A synthetic socio-economic sample survey used to test DDI-Codebook 2.6 metadata extraction, validation, and serialization.</abstract>
    </stdyInfo>
  </stdyDscr>
  <dataDscr>
    <var ID="V1" name="age">
      <labl>Respondent Age</labl>
      <varFormat type="numeric"/>
    </var>
    <var ID="V2" name="gender">
      <labl>Respondent Gender</labl>
      <catgry>
        <catValu>1</catValu>
        <labl>Female</labl>
      </catgry>
      <catgry>
        <catValu>2</catValu>
        <labl>Male</labl>
      </catgry>
    </var>
    <var ID="V3" name="income">
      <labl>Annual Household Income (USD)</labl>
      <varFormat type="numeric"/>
    </var>
  </dataDscr>
</codeBook>"""

# 1. Parse and build Codebook model
codebook = cb.loadxmlstring(xml_content)

# 2. Persist standardized DDI 2.6 XML to shared storage
output_path = "/data/shared/demo_study_ddi.xml"
cb.savexml(codebook, output_path)

# 3. Analyze and validate against DDI-Codebook profile
profile = cb.analyze_ddic_profile(codebook)

return [{
    "json": {
        "status": "success",
        "study_id": profile.study_id,
        "title": profile.title,
        "standard": profile.ddi_standard,
        "standard_version": profile.standard_version,
        "total_variables": profile.summary.total_variables,
        "quality_score": profile.quality.overall_score,
        "quality_grade": profile.quality.grade,
        "xml_output_file": output_path
    }
}]
